text.content:
A junction worn smooth by traffic, its floor cracked and sagging where age has finally caught up with the packed earth.

GM Notes

Hazard: The floor here is unstable and gives way under careless weight (DC 13 to notice before stepping wrong).

Encounter: A patrol or wandering hazard tied to the floor's threat also passes through here on a rotation; a failed Perception check meets it head-on. Both problems can occur together for a genuinely bad afternoon - a patrol arriving mid-collapse is a good time to let the goblins panic instead of fight.
